description: This file defines the Calendar class for SuiteCRM, handling calendar-related functionalities such as loading activities, managing views, calculating date ranges, and initializing shared user data within the calendar module.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Represents the calendar component in SuiteCRM, managing calendar views, activities, user preferences, and date calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Calendar object, setting up view mode, date parameters, user preferences, and time settings.

methods.name: load_activities
methods.description: Loads activities data into internal arrays from scheduled activities and external sources.

methods.name: init_shared
methods.description: Initializes shared user IDs for calendar sharing features.

methods.name: calculate_grid_start_ts
methods.description: Calculates the start timestamp for the calendar grid based on the current view.

methods.name: calculate_day_range
methods.description: Calculates the number of time slots per day and determines day start/end in minutes.

methods.name: add_activities
methods.description: Adds activities for a particular user based on the current calendar view and date range.

methods.name: get_neighbor_date_str
methods.description: Returns the date string of the previous or next calendar grid period.

methods.name: isPrint
methods.description: Returns whether the calendar is in print mode.
